name: EFG-Hermes Holding S.A.E
summary: EFG-Hermes Holding S.A.E., a financial services company, provides investment banking products and services primarily in the Egypt, Gulf Cooperation Council, and Lebanon. The company provides securities brokerage services for institutions and individual clients; investment banking services; and asset management products, such as traditional and alternative investments comparing equity, fixed-income, money-market, and balanced funds, as well as Shariah compliant mandates. It also offers private equity; commercial banking services; and non-bank finance products, including leasing and micro-finance, installment services, factoring, securitization, and collection services. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in 6th of October, Egypt.

name: Commercial International Bank Egypt (CIB) S.A.E.
summary: Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E provides retail, corporate, and investment banking services in Egypt. The company operates in following segments: Corporate Banking, Investment, Retail Banking, and Others. It offers current and saving accounts, easy accounts, time deposits, and certificates of deposit; and personal/overdraft/mortgage, educational, solar, travel, car finance, and unsecured personal loans, as well as revolving overdraft salary upfront services. The company also offers global transaction and digital banking; and cash management services, as well as corporate banking services. In addition, it provides credit, debit, and prepaid cards, smart wallet, mobile, Internet, phone banking, and ATM services. Further, the company offers other credit facilities; derivative products; financial instruments trading, structured financing, corporate leasing, and merger and acquisitions advisory; and foreign currency services, as well as assets liabilities services. Additionally, the company provides structured financing, corporate leasing, merger, and acquisition services, as well as trades in financial instruments. Furthermore, the company offers investment savings products, consumer loans and mortgage services. The company was formerly known as Chase National Bank. Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Giza, Egypt.

name: EFG Holding S.A.E. Sponsored GDR RegS
summary: EFG-Hermes Holding S.A.E. (EFGD.IL) is a prominent financial services institution, primarily operating across Egypt, the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, and Lebanon. The company delivers a comprehensive suite of financial solutions, including: Investment banking expertise, which encompasses securities brokerage for both institutional and individual clients. A robust asset management division offering a diverse array of products. These include various mutual funds, discretionary portfolios, and specialized mandates covering equities, money markets, fixed income, indexed strategies, as well as Sharia-compliant and UCITS-regulated options. Further expanding its offerings, EFG-Hermes engages in private equity investments and provides commercial banking services. Crucially, the firm is a significant provider of non-bank financial products, covering a wide spectrum such as leasing, microfinance, consumer finance, mortgage finance, installment services, factoring, securitization, collection services, and various payment solutions. Its broad client base spans institutional investors, retail customers, individual entrepreneurs, large corporations, and small to micro-enterprises. Established in 1984, EFG-Hermes Holding S.A.E. maintains its headquarters in 6th of October, Egypt.

name: EFG Holding S.A.E. Sponsored GDR RegS
summary: EFG Holding SAE is a prominent firm specializing in a comprehensive range of financial services. Its diverse operations are structured across several key areas, including holding and treasury functions, brokerage, asset management, investment banking, private equity, leasing, micro finance, consumer finance, and factoring. The company was established on January 1, 1984, by Mohamed Taymour, and its main office is situated in 6th of October City, Egypt.

name: EDITA FOOD INDUSTRIES SAE
summary: Edita Food Industries SAE is an Egypt-based company that manufactures, markets, and distributes a range of packaged snack foods, including croissants, cakes, rusks (baked bread), and wafers. The company's products are sold under well-known brands, and it has a significant market share in Egypt. Its headquarters is located in Cairo, Egypt.

name: JUHAYNA FOOD INDUSTRIES
summary: Juhayna Food Industries is an Egypt-based company that manufactures and distributes dairy and juice products. The company's product portfolio includes milk, yogurt, juice, and other related products, sold under the Juhayna brand and other brands. The company is headquartered in Giza, Egypt.
